Cadre 3.0.1 fixes project creation in the published npm package and hardens the
release boundary for all ten native workflows and the complete immutable
template catalog.

## Changes since 3.0.0

- **Fixes published `create`.** npm treated the nested template `.gitignore`
  as packlist configuration, omitted `project/gitignore`, and caused
  `project_init_preview` to fail. The provider asset now uses the
  packaging-safe physical name `gitignore.template` while retaining the same
  logical ID, content, generated `.cadre/.gitignore` path, and behavior.
- **Fails fast on incomplete packages.** The runtime now defines all 38 `v1`
  template IDs as an explicit contract. `cadre-ai doctor`, the installer, and
  MCP startup reject missing, unexpected, or duplicate templates before Cadre
  state or marketplace contents can be changed.
- **Tests the real npm boundary.** Package regression coverage verifies all ten
  skills, both workers, both bundles, native manifests, MCP configurations,
  and every template against npm's actual packlist. The other nine workflows
  were audited and have no missing package assets.
- **Links canonical documentation.** Both the repository and npm READMEs now
  point prominently to [cadre-docs.pages.dev](https://cadre-docs.pages.dev/).

This patch does not change commands, project state schemas, template content,
or migration requirements. Existing Cadre 3.0 projects remain compatible.

## Install or upgrade

```bash
npm install -g cadre-ai@3.0.1
cadre-ai doctor
cadre-ai install --target all --scope user
```

Start a new Codex conversation and run `/reload-plugins` in Claude Code after
installation.

## Verification

- Locked workspace installation with pnpm 11.4.0.
- Harness TypeScript check, all 40 CLI/integration tests, package validation,
  and npm dry-run packing.
- Complete docs content, lint, typecheck, and static production build.
- Local-build installation with `cadre@cadre` enabled for Codex and Claude at
  the 3.0.1 candidate version.
- Installed MCP smoke test confirming all 38 templates and a successful
  `project_init_preview` containing `.gitignore`.

Read the [detailed release notes](https://cadre-docs.pages.dev/release-notes/)
or the [full 3.0.0...3.0.1 comparison](https://github.com/vishal-kr-barnwal/cadre/compare/release-3.0.0...release-3.0.1).
